title: Mobile Car Detailing in Mill Bay: What to Expect
metaDescription: Looking for mobile car detailing in Mill Bay, BC? Here's what Ashton's Auto Detailing offers, how it works, and what it costs for local homeowners.
excerpt: Mill Bay residents don't need to drive into town for a quality detail. Here's how mobile detailing works right in your driveway.

content.text: Mill Bay is one of the areas we detail in most often, and for good reason — waterfront homes, gravel driveways, and a healthy dose of ferry-terminal dust mean vehicles here need regular attention. If you've been searching for car detailing near Mill Bay, here's exactly what to expect from a mobile appointment.

We bring everything: water tank, generator or power draw, and professional-grade products. All we need from you is a spot in the driveway and about 1.5 to 4 hours depending on the package. No dropping the car off, no waiting at a shop.
Why Mill Bay homeowners choose mobile detailing

Between work schedules, ferry commutes, and simply not wanting to lose a car for half a day, mobile detailing fits into how people in Mill Bay actually live. We schedule around you, including evenings and weekends.
Call or text 250-709-1371 for a free quote. We serve Mill Bay and the surrounding Cowichan Valley, including Cobble Hill and Shawnigan Lake.
